transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, I suppose what brings me in is that I realized I keep arranging my own house around not seeing spiders. It's getting very frustrating. I put off doing the laundry just because it's down in the basement, and I completely avoid the garden shed. I've even started paying people to do small jobs around the house that I know perfectly well how to do myself, simply because I can’t make myself go into those spaces.
When you think about or encounter spiders, do you perform any repetitive behaviors or mental rituals to reduce your anxiety, beyond simply avoiding them?

No, I don't do anything like that. I mean, I don't have any routines or... rituals to calm myself down, if that's what you mean. If I see one, I just want to get away from it as fast as possible. So, no, it's really just the avoiding. I just stay away.
